name: A commander added from search is known by its owner's command zone; a stolen commander is still a commander but not its new controller's
notes: Companion to commander-identity-reads-every-player-not-the-open-tab. Player 2's commander Kalemne is added from search, not put onto the battlefield from the command zone, so it is known by name among its owner's commanders. Player 1 enchants it with Control Magic. Player 1's Bastion Protector ('Commander creatures you control') then gives it +2/+2 and indestructible: it is a commander and Player 1 controls it. Player 2's Thunderfoot Baloth ('As long as you control your commander') does nothing: Player 2 no longer controls it. Evaluated from Player 1's tab. Kalemne 5/5 indestructible, Baloth 5/5, Bastion 3/3. Memory: project_commander_identity_by_owner_2026-10-14.
